price_basis: Close as supplied in the pinned Yahoo-sourced CSV; source vintage and split adjustment are not independently verified
issue_availability_assumption: All OHLCV fields of a dated row are available only after that row closes; no intraday prediction claim
label_maturity: target date must be strictly before the half-open split end
embargo: omit the first h observed rows in each stock's dev/test split for horizon h
primary_aggregation: equal issue-date weight; first average errors across available stocks on that date
comparison_conditions: New price-only regression protocol. StockNet paper uses tweets, one-day direction and movement/coverage filters; these scores are not its published-score reproduction.
data_distribution: Raw CSV stays in ignored local work; MIT repository license does not establish independent Yahoo redistribution rights.
